mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% indicates a tightening labor market, which typically boosts corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, which typically leads to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation environment (CPIAUCSL > 255.0) and elevated policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 2.3%), the combination of high inflation and restrictive monetary policy typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE is declining, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) above 1250 thousand units signals strong demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 1250.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 109.0 signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 109.0 and the regime is late-cycle, or the Rank IC for the regime-specific signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher quarterly GDP level (GDPC1) relative to the previous quarter indicates economic expansion, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 is higher than the previous quarter, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
